$comment: AİLE V · war-board — The War Board
Simetrik hedef + alma bir HAMLEDİR + şans aleti YOKTUR.
Bu ailenin editoryal görevi satrancı anlatmak değil, KOMŞULARINI göstermektir.

games.reconstructionPlan: BOŞLUK: fil (hasti) taşının hareketi kaynaklara göre değişir, bu yüzden yasal hamle kümesi tam kapanmaz; berabere de tanımsızdır. KAPATMA: kitap al-Bīrūnī'nin aktardığı iki kare çapraz sıçrama biçimini seçer ve şah çıplak kaldığında oyunun bittiğini, iki taraf da mat edemiyorsa beraberliği basar. DAYANAK: al-Bīrūnī, Hint oyununu doğrudan gözlemleyen en erken ayrıntılı tanıktır; Murray'in derlediği diğer fil biçimleri künyede anılır ama basılmaz. ETİKET: madde 'yeniden kurgulanmış kural' başlığıyla basılır ve satrancın 'atası' anlatısının kesin olmadığı söylenir.
unresolvedQuestions: Dört kollu zarlı biçim (chaturaji) ayrı bir madde mi? O biçim şans aleti taşır ve bu aileye GİREMEZ — race ailesine bakılmalıdır.
games.culturalNotes: Satrancın atası olarak anlatılır ama kuralları tam bilinmez; kitabın 'her şeyi eşit güvenle söylemeyen' sesi için ideal madde.

rules.objective: Take every one of your opponent's pieces.
materials: A board of nine points across and five points down, with diagonals crossing at every second point
substitutions: The grid drawn on paper, ruling the diagonals from the corners so they cross at alternate points
Two colours of dried bean, forty-four in all
rules.setup: Fill the two rows nearest you with your own pieces, eighteen in all. Your opponent does the same. In the middle row, working from the left, place white, black, white, black, then leave the centre point empty, then white, black, white, black. Every point is now occupied except the centre.
turnSequence: Look for a capture; if one is available you must take it.
To capture by approach, step one of your pieces along a line into the point beside an enemy piece.
To capture by withdrawal, step one of your pieces along a line straight away from an adjacent enemy piece.
Remove the enemy piece you moved toward or away from.
Remove every further enemy piece standing behind it, in an unbroken line, in that same direction.
Stop removing at the first empty point or at the first piece of your own colour.
If the piece that just captured can capture again, you may continue with the same piece.
Hand the turn to your opponent.
legalMoves: A piece moves one step along a drawn line to an adjacent empty point.
Diagonal moves are possible only from points where diagonals are drawn.
Capturing is compulsory whenever a capture exists.
A single move may not capture by approach and by withdrawal at once; the player chooses one direction.
During a chain of captures the piece may not move twice in the same direction, and may not return to a point it has already stood on in that chain.
A move that captures nothing is legal only when no capture is available anywhere on the board.
rules.winCondition: You win by capturing all of your opponent's pieces.
rules.endCondition: Play stops when one player has no pieces left, or when neither player can force a capture and both agree the position is dead.

edgeCases.tie: If both players are left with pieces that can never capture again, the game is a draw. The traditional match answer is to play a second game with the colours swapped and count the pair.
edgeCases.stalemate: A player who has pieces but no legal move loses the game. Because a non-capturing move is always allowed when no capture exists, this is rare and usually means the pieces are completely boxed in.
edgeCases.illegalMove: Put the piece back and return any pieces taken. If a capture was available and the player moved elsewhere, the move is replayed as a capture. If several captures were available, the player still chooses which one.

variants.name: Fanoron-Dimyandimy
variants.note: A three by five board, five pieces each side. It teaches approach and withdrawal in about five minutes.

variants.name: Fanoron-Telo
variants.note: A three by three board and three pieces each; the aim is a row of three rather than capture. It belongs with the alignment games and is worth showing alongside as a contrast.

rules.simplifiedFirstGame: Play on the three by five board with five pieces each and drop the chain rule: one capture per turn, then the turn passes. This keeps both capture directions, which are the whole point of the game, and gives a five-minute first sitting.

games.reconstructionPlan: BOŞLUK: taş sayısı, tahta boyutu ve başlangıç dizilimi bilinmiyor; berabere ve döngü tanımsız. KAPATMA: kitap Stanway mezarındaki 8×12 tahtayı ve orada BULUNDUĞU HÂLİYLE duran taş sayısını temel alır, taşları arka sıraya dizer ve art arda üç tur alma olmazsa oyunu kalan taş sayısına göre bitirir. DAYANAK: Stanway buluntusu, antik dünyadan bize kalan tek kurulu latrunculi konumudur — kural metni yerine ARKEOLOJİ konuşur. ETİKET: madde 'yeniden kurgulanmış kural' başlığıyla basılır; Latin yazarların oyunu övüp kuralını hiç yazmadığı ayrıca söylenir.
unresolvedQuestions: Hangi yeniden kurgulama basılacak? Kitap tek yorum seçer ve 'yeniden kurgulanmış' etiketini görünür basar.
games.culturalNotes: Stanway mezarındaki tahta, taşlar YERİNDE duracak biçimde bulunmuştur — antik dünyadan bize kalan tek kurulu oyun konumu.
